text: The Reyrolle 7SR54 relay provides protection, control and monitoring for 2 and 3 winding transformers. It supports all transformer vector groups and earthing connections or comprehensive coverage for your electrical network.
heading: Why Reyrolle 7SR54?

text: Managing complex transformer operations requires multiple types of protection against faults and disturbances. The Reyrolle 7SR54 includes a wide variety of protection functions and advanced IEC 61850 Ethernet communications to help you maintain system stability and prevent costly downtime.
heading: Why Reyrolle 7SR54?

text: The user-friendly interface with a large LCD and tactile pushbuttons simplifies operation and maintenance. The withdrawable relay element allows for easy replacement for less service interruptions.
heading: Why Reyrolle 7SR54?

text: Deliver reliable protection for 2- and 3-winding transformers, auto-transformers, reactors and motors. Our proven algorithms safeguard your critical assets and electrical network.
heading: Protect your transformers

text: Improve your bottom line with a compact design and low product life-cycle cost. The withdrawable relay element allows for easy replacement, simplifying maintenance.
heading: Reduce costs

text: Enable higher availability with IEC 61850 Edition 1 & 2, DNP3 TCP and Modbus TCP, supporting HSR, PRP and RSTP operation. Role Based Access Control and signed firmware provide enhanced cybersecurity.
heading: Increase system availability

text: Deploy a wide range of protection and detection functions. The Reyrolle 7SR54 supports all transformer vector groups and earthing connections for comprehensive coverage across your network.
heading: Comprehensive protection functions

text: Utilize up to 12 current inputs, 4 voltage inputs, 37 binary inputs and 18 binary outputs. The power supply and binary inputs cover the full operating range with configurable thresholds for adaptable system integration.
heading: Input and output options

text: Use IEC 61850 Ethernet communications and a front USB port for configuration and rear RS485. A large LCD, tactile pushbuttons and programmable LEDs provide a user-friendly interface for easy management.
